label: P1: Contract + spine: one writer, stamped descriptor events (u0, u1)
P2: Role + governance records (u2 ∥ u3)
instructions: Implement exactly ONE phase using the plan's testing approach and domain placement rules — keep the task table and execution.log.md live as you go.
Run /builder 6 implement --plan "<plan path>"; log discoveries, tagging any Deferred/Noteworthy a human must see before ship.
Done when the phase's acceptance criteria are met, the tests pass, and the execution log records what changed plus the proof.

Mutate task state through the CLI, never an editor: node_modules/.bin/dd set "<plan dir>/assets/tasks/phase-N/tasks.dd.json#tasks/tk-XXXX/state" checked (and #done_when/tk-XXXX/dw-XXXX/state for each assertion). The .dd.md sibling is GENERATED — editing it is drift.

Rehearse this node's gate before you try to leave: harness plan validate "<plan dir>/plan.dd.json" --address "<plan dir>/assets/tasks/phase-N/tasks.dd.json#tasks". Gate-terminal states are checked, human-skipped, na; unchecked and blocked hold it.
Spend tokens where they can change the outcome; use `--quiet` for routine flow mutations.
Match model tier to work: chores -> cheap subagent, analysis -> Opus-class, judgement -> lead; context may override (§ Shared conventions).
Environment friction is work, not an apology: fix small things, otherwise `harness observe` it — is this environment working for us? (builder SKILL.md invariant #14)

label: Review: P2
instructions: Review exactly ONE phase's diff against its acceptance criteria — confirm the tests prove behaviour and nothing risky slipped in.
Run /builder 7 review — it inspects the newest assets/reviews/*.md and surfaces a verdict; REQUEST_CHANGES loops back to fix, clean continues to the next phase or post-flight.
Done when the verdict is recorded (one finding line) and either accepted or routed to a fix-loop.

This node carries the plan-validate CHECK gate: departure is refused until harness plan validate "<plan dir>/plan.dd.json" --complete is green (zero errors AND zero warnings). Run it BEFORE you try to leave — the refusal quotes every finding, but reading them early is cheaper.

Close criteria through the CLI: node_modules/.bin/dd set "<plan dir>/plan.dd.json#acceptance_criteria/ac-XXXX/state" checked, and re-verify any moved basis with node_modules/.bin/dd link verify-basis <address> --sha <sha> --update <doc>.
If the gate refuses and departing anyway is the HUMAN's decision, they pass --force — it records a defended override. An agent may not force a dd gate on its own judgment.

label: Boot check
instructions: Pre-flight seam: confirm the harness is healthy before you start coding this phase.
Run /eng-harness-flow --hook pre-flight --json — a REAL invocation; narrate its envelope verbatim, never fabricate one. A manual `harness boot` (or any prior evidence) never satisfies this seam.
Spend tokens where they can change the outcome; use `--quiet` for routine flow mutations.
Match model tier to work: chores -> cheap subagent, analysis -> Opus-class, judgement -> lead; context may override (§ Shared conventions).

On done, receipt first, status second: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node boot-2 --kind validation --source agent --text "verdict:<…> time:<…>" (router missing / envelope noop/UNAVAILABLE → text "decision:unavailable reason:<…> time:<…>" — a completed attempt, not a skip) THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node boot-2 --to done. Mandatory unless the human declines — a decline is: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node boot-2 --kind decision --source user --text "<their verbatim words>" THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node boot-2 --to skipped.
